entries.8f9211bb0801af96: Under its Long-term Management Vision formulated in March 2025, the company aims to close the gap between its desired future state, targeted for around 2040, and its current situation. Its business strategy sets four directions: realizing an overwhelming No.1 presence along its rail lines, maximizing the appeal of its content and developing new content, expanding beyond its area (Greater Tokyo Area and overseas), and focusing on business solutions; it states that it will continue to deepen existing fields centered on its rail lines and take on challenges in new fields with expected growth. Under its financial strategy, the Urban Transportation Business and the Real Estate Leasing and Development Business stably generate funds that are channeled into growth businesses; it positions the Real Estate Business (Global), Housing Business, Hotel Business, Information Services Business and Travel Business, among others, as playing a role in driving group growth. Under its human resources strategy, it states that it will secure diverse and capable personnel, deploy them in growth areas, and systematically develop personnel to lead the future.

entries.e02014a78ec78992: This is a reportable segment comprising four categories: leasing and other businesses, housing business, overseas real estate business, and hotel business. Its core company is Hankyu Hanshin Properties Co., Ltd. Hankyu Corporation and Hanshin Electric Railway Co., Ltd. are also responsible for the leasing and other businesses and the housing business. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥396,184 million, the largest among the reportable segments. Operating revenue including intersegment transactions was ¥406,705 million (up 10.6% year on year), with condominium sales revenue rising significantly. From the current fiscal year, the sub-segment “Leasing Business” has been renamed “Leasing and Other Businesses,” and “Sales and Other Businesses” has been renamed “Housing Business.” Property management and building maintenance businesses and real estate fund and REIT businesses, which were previously included in “Sales and Other Businesses,” are now presented within “Leasing and Other Businesses.”

entries.e3f97d9712ccd72b: This is a reportable segment engaged in the information services business, the broadcasting and telecommunications business, and the safety and education business, and the business description table lists Itec Hankyu Hanshin Co., Ltd., Yumilink Co., Ltd., and Bay Communications Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥55,778 million, and revenue including intersegment transactions was ¥71,968 million (up 2.7% year on year). In the information services business, results were strong, driven by growth in internet-related businesses such as e-commerce and orders for the transport terminal operation system at the Osaka-Kansai Expo. In the broadcasting and telecommunications business, the company provides FTTH services (high-speed internet services using optical fiber) and has also received orders from local governments for projects such as ICT environment development at elementary and junior high schools. In the safety and education business, the number of schools and facilities introducing “Tōkōkō Mimamorume” increased, and the company operates the robot programming school “Puroguraboo.”

entries.ed3e205ae797cc8f: This is a reportable segment engaged in travel business, and the company listed in the business descriptions table is Hankyu Travel International Co., Ltd. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥295,768 million, the second largest among the reportable segments after the real estate business. Operating revenue including intersegment transactions was ¥296,546 million (up 13.6% year on year). In overseas travel, handling of long-haul tours led by Europe increased, and domestic travel also performed steadily through early tour sales and an expanded product lineup. Inbound travel to Japan saw strong tour sales against the backdrop of rising inbound demand; in addition to undertaking transport support work for the Osaka-Kansai Expo, it is actively winning solutions business orders from local governments.
